front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《35》

en: You ask how far the ends of the earth are?
In truth, I have always kept it in mind
You, at the edge of the sea
A thousand sails have passed
How many moods
Falling into the tender slanting light

points.zh:
梳洗罷
獨倚望江樓
過盡千帆皆不是
斜暉脈脈水悠悠
腸斷白蘋州
--唐 。溫庭筠《夢江南》
points.en:
Having finished washing and dressing,
I lean alone on the river-watching tower.
A thousand sails pass by, none of them his,
the slanting sunlight lingers, the water flows on endlessly,
my heart breaks at Baiping Island.
-- Tang dynasty. Wen Tingyun, 'Dreaming of the South'

en: Late spring, the month of May
Outside the window, hazy fine rain
Farther still, willows lingering tenderly

zh: 敦煌的佛，累坐千年枯寂
en: The Buddha of Dunhuang, sitting weary through a thousand years of desolation
May he return his body to earth, to dust
Drifting back to India with the flying apsaras

points.zh: 飛天，佛家語，是佛教中天帝司樂之神，飛天最早誕生於古印度，後傳入中國，與中國藝術融合。魏晉南北朝初期，壁畫中的飛天亦稱飛仙。莫高窟492個洞窟中，幾乎皆畫有飛天。
points.en: Feitian (flying apsaras) is a Buddhist term referring to the heavenly deities of music in Buddhism. The feitian first appeared in ancient India before being introduced to China, where it merged with Chinese art. In the early Wei-Jin and Northern and Southern Dynasties period, the feitian in murals were also called 'flying immortals.' Almost all of the 492 caves of Mogao Grottoes contain paintings of feitian.

en: Sky eternal and vast, no self
One season of wind and moon, with you in it
The realm of Zen, rain upon the palm
Small grass stands trembling, alone
Looking back
Fallen blossoms cover the ground
Old pond, a frog leaps in
Wrinkling a banana-leaf haiku
What business is it of yours

points.zh:
日本俳聖松尾芭蕉的經典俳句:
古池
青蛙跳入
水聲響
points.en:
A classic haiku by the Japanese haiku sage Matsuo Basho:
Old pond—
a frog leaps in,
the sound of water.

en: Walking to where the water ends
The dust of the world now far away, sitting to watch
Clouds, emerging from the peaks without intent
After the rain
The color of the grass hazy and lost
Waiting quietly for the late-rising moon

points.zh:
North Carolina, Outer Banks Beach.    son Erling and granddaughter Sarah.
《阿爸的風吹》   鄭智仁  詞/曲
阮阿爸　教阮來做風吹
伊講你敢知　咱人生親像風吹焉耳飛
飛呀飛　風愈大愈高　有時會飛入濛霧中　
飛呀飛　風愈大愈高　有時乎風來騙不知
阮阿爸　率阮去放風吹
伊講有一工　你若會親像風吹焉耳飛
飛呀飛呀　愈飛愈高　看到的物就愈未清
飛呀飛呀　愈飛愈高　不當忘記線的起頭彼雙手
風吹呀飛　風吹呀飛　飛過阮細漢一直有的夢
風吹呀飛　風吹呀飛　飛過阮懵懂的夢
